gate: component paper: surface-EMG continuous speech recognizer (bundled phonetic-feature streams) with a new corpus
prep: no prep/ directory; plan and M06 audit built by the writer; published topic tables reused append-only: M06/articulatory-signal-speech-recognizer (dated population), M03/emg-cross-speaker-training-and-calibration; arxiv-2403.05583 checked note reused from M12/emg-text-unseen-sentence-test
time_frame: first public 2009-12 (accepted manuscript online; received 2008-12). Prior = before 2009-06; [concurrent] = 2009-06 to 2010-06. Same-group priors counted as distinct designs: Jou 2006 (Interspeech), Walliczek 2006, Jou 2007 (ICASSP, AF streams), Wand and Schultz 2009b (BIOSIGNALS, CD triphones, held-out speaker). Wand et al. 2009 (Interspeech, BDPF on the same corpus, cites the target) and Toth et al. 2009 are [concurrent]. Wand and Schultz 2009a (CCIS) is an extended version of 2009b, not in the wiki, merged.
setting: One setting across slots: decoders of speech from non-acoustic speech-production signals measured on the speaker; acoustic-input ASR (the AF-stream lineage of Kirchhoff and Metze that the target cites) and lip-video-only recognition are outside the counts and named through the target's citations.

inherited.M01: Read BASE/SPEC sentences, audible and mouthed; EMG-PIT corpus (14 pilot plus 64 main speakers)
inherited.M02: Phone labels from acoustic forced alignment of the parallel audio (Broadcast News recognizer)
inherited.M04: Audible read speech scored; silent mode recorded but not scored
inherited.M05: Five Varioport channels, 600 Hz, TD15 features with LDA to 32 dimensions (group's Jou 2006 lineage)
inherited.M07: Broadcast News trigram, 101-word test vocabulary, lattice rescoring of LM weight and word penalty
